cp_a.title_zh: 与内部审计联络的好处
cp_a.title_en: Benefits of Liaising with Internal Audit
cp_a.reason: Core review point collecting the key benefits of regular communication and collaboration with internal audit.

units.zh: 金融犯罪防控专业人员应与内部审计团队定期沟通协作以准备审计。
units.en: To prepare for audits and maintain effective control programs, AFC professionals should communicate and collaborate with their internal audit team on a regular basis. Liaising with internal audit helps to:

units.zh: 与内部审计沟通可确认并统一审查范围，确保双方理解期望与目标。
units.en: Confirm and align review scope: Engaging with internal audit clarifies the aspects of the AFC program that will be under review and facilitates sharing of risk assessments. This ensures mutual understanding of expectations and objectives, allowing the teams to focus on the most critical areas.

units.zh: 与内部审计协调可确保充分准备，包括收集文件、安排利益相关方并处理初步问题。
units.en: Prepare for the review: Coordinating with internal audit ensures adequate preparation. This includes gathering necessary documentation, ensuring relevant stakeholders are available, and addressing preliminary questions. Preparation minimizes disruptions and improves the audit process. For example, business practices such as regular risk and control selfassessments (RCSA) allow functions to self-identify deficiencies and implement action plans. Data from RCSA exercises also serve as valuable inputs for internal audits.

units.zh: 审计后持续沟通有助于制定行动计划，反洗钱合规团队可及时实施改进。
units.en: Plan actions after review: After the audit, ongoing communication helps develop actionable plans in response to the results. By discussing recommendations and prioritizing actions, the AML compliance team can implement improvements promptly.

units.zh: 与内部审计的良好关系有助于识别合规控制和运营流程中需要改进的领域。
units.en: Identify areas for improvement: A strong working relationship with internal audit fosters an environment where feedback is valued. Regular interaction helps identify areas needing improvement in compliance controls and operational processes, leading to proactive enhancements before issues escalate.

units.zh: 与内部审计密切合作可确保控制程序按预期运行。
units.en: Ensure effective control programs: Close collaboration with internal audit ensures that control programs function as intended.

cp_b.title_zh: 可疑活动报告流程的文档与审计线索
cp_b.title_en: Documentation and Audit Trail for SAR Process
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 创建审计线索，记录合规步骤及不准确或误匹配的解决过程
units.en: To demonstrate that an organization has undertaken appropriate research to prevent financial crime, it is important to create an audit trail. This means documenting all steps the team has taken to demonstrate compliance efforts to auditors and the supervisory authorities. Include how any inaccuracies or false matches were resolved.

units.zh: 研究应在执行时立即记录，并标注日期和时间戳
units.en: It is important to document the research at the time it is performed. A search today might turn up very different results than a search performed in several months, when a decision is being questioned. Even those searches that do not produce target or relevant matches should be documented with appropriate date and time stamps.

units.zh: 记录搜索字符串、逻辑和关键词，以证明遵循了基于风险的方法
units.en: Document the search strings, logic, and keywords. Sometimes the method and logic behind generating search results can be as important as the results themselves. Documentation will help demonstrate that the team has followed a risk-based approach.

units.zh: 信息来源的可靠性比较：较旧来源通常可靠性较低
units.en: Some of this will be straightforward, as one source may be older and therefore less reliable than another source.

units.zh: 按照机构记录保留政策，以PDF、打印件等形式保存文档
units.en: Save documentation as PDFs, printed out, or collected in some other manner according to the organization’s record retention policy.

units.zh: 详尽的文档记录支持基于风险的方法，即使信息不全，过程本身也可辩护
units.en: Thorough documentation provides a record to support your organization’s risk-based approach. So, even if you fail to capture every relevant piece of information, the process itself is defensible.

units.zh: 研究文档必须妥善安全存储，以遵守隐私法和数据安全要求
units.en: Once documented, your research should be properly and securely stored to respect privacy laws and data security.

units.zh: 内部审计、监管机构和执法部门可能审查文档记录，执法部门可能在法庭上使用
units.en: Internal auditors, regulators, and law enforcement might review the documented findings, and law enforcement might use them in court.

units.zh: 注意数据隐私法律和数据安全协议
units.en: Be aware of data privacy laws and data security protocols.

units.zh: 可接受的研究工具、数据库和方法因机构和司法管辖区而异
units.en: Tools, databases, and methods for research that may be acceptable for one organization may not be acceptable in another organization or jurisdiction.

units.zh: 应建立流程，在收集信息时同步记录研究，以防遗漏
units.en: A process should be in place to document the research as information is collected, so nothing is lost or forgotten.

units.zh: 制定研究笔记和标准模板有助于确保捕获所有必要信息
units.en: Developing research notes and a standard template increases the likelihood that all required information will be captured.

cp_a.reason: A list of risk indicators (high false positives, unexpected alert volumes, no alerts) that signal the need for manual tuning, introduced by contextual unit 4245.

units.zh: 筛查系统产生异常高的误报预警比例
units.en: The screening system generates a remarkably high percentage of false positive alerts.

units.zh: 系统生成的预警数量超出预期
units.en: The system generates more alerts than expected.

units.zh: 筛查系统未生成任何预警
units.en: The screening system generates no alerts.

units.zh: 列举需要进行手动调优的指标
units.en: Indicators that lead to manual tuning include:

cp_b.reason: Discusses fuzzy logic, AI, calibration challenges, and machine learning to refine screening; a coherent block on advanced techniques.

units.zh: 模糊逻辑算法允许近似名称匹配，处理拼写和音译差异。
units.en: These organizations require more advanced methodologies, such as fuzzy logic algorithms. These algorithms enable approximate name matching, allowing for variations in spelling and transliteration errors.

units.zh: 高级AI工具可扫描整个文档和交易细节以检测隐藏风险，防止规避制裁等行为。
units.en: Advanced AI tools can scan entire documents and transaction details to detect hidden risks. These tools help ensure that criminals do not exploit complex financial products and transactions for the purpose of evading sanctions or engaging in other illicit activities.

units.zh: 复杂技术带来校准挑战：严格阈值导致高误报，宽松阈值可能漏掉严重犯罪。
units.en: Although sophisticated technologies enhance detection capabilities, they also introduce challenges in calibration. A conservative approach with strict thresholds might result in high false positives, leading to inefficiencies and unnecessary transaction delays. Conversely, overly lenient thresholds might allow serious financial crimes to proceed undetected.

units.zh: 机器学习从历史结果中学习以优化参数，实时更新帮助持续调整筛查模型。
units.en: Machine learning allows the system to learn from previous results to refine the parameters, helping to strike the right balance. This helps maintain regulatory compliance while minimizing disruptions to legitimate transactions. Financial institutions can use real-time updates to adjust and tune screening filters to continuously refine their screening models.

units.zh: 支付筛查的技术复杂程度取决于机构的应用和风险状况。
units.en: The level of technological sophistication in payment screening depends on the institution’s application and risk profile.

units.zh: 对于客户已知的小型企业，简单的名称匹配工具可能足够。
units.en: Simple, traditional tools with namematching techniques might suffice for small businesses with known clientele.

units.zh: 对于处理数百万笔交易的大型金融机构，基本名称匹配不够用。
units.en: However, for larger financial institutions handling millions of transactions, basic name matching is insufficient.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Initial Assessment of Existing Systems and Data Quality

cp_a.title_zh: 结构化与非结构化数据
cp_a.reason: This core_point contrasts the structured nature of internal data with the often unstructured nature of external data, defines unstructured data, and notes the processing required, providing a unified review concept.

units.zh: 内部数据通常是结构化格式，易于组织控制
units.en: Internal data is often in a structured format, which makes it easier for the organization to control.

units.zh: 非结构化数据定义：非固定格式的数据，如注释字段中的自由文本
units.en: Unstructured data is data that is not provided in a fixed format, such as free text that appears in a comment field.

units.zh: 外部数据来源多样，可能非结构化或与合规系统不兼容
units.en: External data originates from many diverse sources, which might make it unstructured or incompatible with compliance systems.

units.zh: 非结构化数据需要额外处理才能转换为可用格式
units.en: This requires additional work to refine it into a usable format.

cp_b.title_zh: 现有系统与数据质量的初步评估
cp_b.title_en: Initial Assessment of Existing Systems and Data Quality
cp_b.reason: Covers the necessary initial step of assessing existing systems and the impact of poor data quality, forming a foundational review point for tool integration.

units.zh: 选择实施新金融犯罪防控工具前需评估现有系统、数据质量和集成挑战
units.en: When choosing and implementing a new AFC tool, organizations should first conduct a thorough assessment of existing systems, data quality, and integration challenges. A critical step is determining whether legacy databases and platforms are outdated and if they can be effectively migrated into the new system.

units.zh: 结构不良或不一致的数据严重影响机器学习等下一代金融犯罪防控技术效果
units.en: Poorly structured or inconsistent data can severely impact the effectiveness of next-generation technologies such as machine learning, contextual monitoring, and other forms of AI.

cp_a.reason: Covers the varying scope of authority among law enforcement agencies, with examples.

units.zh: 执法机构的权限范围因所在地和犯罪类型而异
units.en: Depending on their location, law enforcement agencies have varying scopes of authority for addressing different types of crime.

units.zh: 例如地方警察与国家级或联邦机构的职责不同
units.en: For example, local police have different responsibilities compared to national or federal agencies.

units.zh: 部分执法机构可能还承担其他职责
units.en: Some law enforcement agencies might also have other responsibilities.

units.zh: 例如税务机关既负责调查税务犯罪也负责制定税收政策
units.en: For example, tax authorities can be responsible for investigating tax crime as well as setting tax policy.

cp_b.title_zh: 治理委员会法定人数构成
cp_b.reason: Describes the typical membership of governance committees, including the three lines of defense.

units.zh: 董事会或高管为金融犯罪防控提供战略监督和资源分配
units.en: Board members or senior executives to provide strategic oversight and resource allocation for AFC compliance.

units.zh: 首席合规官、MLRO或其代表领导金融犯罪防控政策执行、风险评估和监管沟通
units.en: The chief compliance officer, MLRO, or their delegates to lead AFC policy execution, risk assessments, and regulatory engagement.

units.zh: 第一道防线的风险负责人和运营负责人负责在日常运营中实施金融犯罪防控政策
units.en: The first line of defense risk owner and operational leaders who implement AFC policies in daily operations.

units.zh: 第二道防线提供独立监督、政策执行和风险评估
units.en: The second line of defense to provide independent oversight, policy enforcement, and risk assessments (in addition to the MLRO, if needed).

units.zh: 第三道防线报告独立审计并确保合规有效性，同时保持独立性
units.en: The third line of defense to report independent audits and ensure compliance effectiveness, where appropriate, while maintaining independence.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Capabilities of modern AI-driven transaction monitoring

cp_a.reason: Groups the classification of four components with the definitions and details of the components explicitly covered (scenario setting, threshold setting, frequency).

units.zh: 调优包括场景设置、客户细分、阈值设置和频率四个关键组成部分。
units.en: Tuning involves four key components: scenario setting, customer segmentation, threshold setting, and frequency.

units.zh: 场景设置是基于以往经验创建、修改或移除检测规则和场景。
units.en: Scenario setting involves creating, modifying, or removing detection rules and scenarios based on previous experiences with suspicious activity and actual incidents.

units.zh: 阈值设置定义了触发警报所需的最低活动水平。
units.en: Threshold setting defines the minimum level of activity required for a transaction to trigger an alert.

units.zh: 货币交易报告（CTR）阈值示例：超过10,000美元的任何货币交易
units.en: For example, the threshold for reporting a CTR might be any currency transaction that exceeds US$10,000.

units.zh: 调整阈值可提高交易监控系统的灵敏度和准确性
units.en: Adjusting thresholds refines sensitivity and accuracy.

units.zh: 减少误报是设定阈值的关键目标，以高效利用资源
units.en: Reducing the number of false positives is a key goal in setting thresholds to make the most efficient use of resources.

units.zh: 调优频率决定了交易监控系统应多久进行一次调整
units.en: The frequency determines how often tuning should occur.

units.zh: 调优频率受业务策略变化、异常、监管更新或市场变化影响
units.en: The frequency might also be influenced by changes in business strategy, anomalies, regulatory updates, or market changes.

cp_b.title_zh: 现代AI驱动交易监控的功能
cp_b.title_en: Capabilities of modern AI-driven transaction monitoring
cp_b.reason: Lists the specific capabilities of AI-driven TM tools: anomaly detection, strategic threat analysis, time reduction, early warning, and parameter tuning, as explored by Thomas for system update. Provides a concise review point for modern TM features.

units.zh: 跨多笔交易、关系和实体检测异常
units.en: Detect anomalies across multiple transactions, relationships, and entities.

units.zh: 进行战略威胁分析并开发直观的调查流程
units.en: Conduct strategic threat analyses and develop intuitive investigative processes.

units.zh: 基于情报的决策将调查时间从数周缩短至数小时
units.en: Make intelligence-led decisions that reduce investigative time from weeks to hours.

units.zh: 识别财务困境的早期迹象，在风险升级前加以缓解
units.en: Identify early signs of financial distress, mitigating risks before they escalate.

units.zh: 通过学习现有阈值的表现来微调警报参数
units.en: Fine-tune alert parameters by learning from the performance of existing thresholds.

units.zh: Thomas探索市场上可用的AI驱动技术解决方案以收集内外部数据
units.en: Returning to his task of updating the current TM system, Thomas explores AIdriven technology solutions available on the market. These tools will gather internal and external data to:

units.zh: 交易监控从被动合规演变为主动情报驱动系统，AI提升效率
units.en: Understanding how TM has evolved from a reactive compliance function into a proactive, intelligence-driven system, Thomas realizes the importance of continuously updating and improving systems. By using AI and advanced analytics, his bank will have powerful tools to detect, prevent, and mitigate financial crime more efficiently.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Importance of Cooperation between Authorities in AML

cp_a.title_zh: 公私合作伙伴关系的用途
cp_a.reason: Groups the three key purposes of public-private partnerships into one review outline node about their uses.

units.zh: 公私部门合作打击金融犯罪
units.en: Enable collaboration between the public and private sectors in fighting financial crime.

units.zh: 通过信息共享支持执法调查
units.en: Support law enforcement investigations by sharing information.

units.zh: 提供情报和分析以打击金融犯罪
units.en: Provide intelligence and analysis that leads to disruption of financial crime.

units.zh: 公私合作伙伴关系的用途列表引导句
units.en: Public-private partnerships can be used to:

cp_b.title_zh: 反洗钱中当局合作的重要性
cp_b.title_en: Importance of Cooperation between Authorities in AML
cp_b.reason: The section's key takeaways focus on the necessity and outcome of cooperation, with institutional examples; thus one review point is appropriate.

units.zh: 金融情报机构与执法机构合作可促成执法行动
units.en: Cooperation between FIUs and law enforcement results in law enforcement action.

units.zh: 打击洗钱需要国内与国际合作及信息共享
units.en: Addressing money laundering requires cooperation and information sharing both domestically and internationally.

units.zh: Eurojust和Europol等国际机构在协调此类活动中发挥重要作用
units.en: International bodies such as Eurojust and Europol have an important role in coordinating such activity.

cp_a.reason: Grouped definition and characteristics of fuzzy logic matching models.

units.zh: 模糊逻辑匹配模型使用算法匹配相似但不完全相同的名称
units.en: Fuzzy logic matching models use algorithms to match names that are similar but not identical, accounting for variations in spelling, typos, and translations.

units.zh: 模糊逻辑匹配降低因名称细微差异或错误而遗漏匹配的风险
units.en: It improves detection by reducing the risk of missing matches due to minor differences or errors in names.

units.zh: 模糊逻辑匹配灵活但需要复杂算法和持续调优
units.en: Although flexible and capable of handling a variety of names, it requires sophisticated algorithms and constant tuning.

units.zh: 宽泛的匹配标准可能导致误报风险
units.en: Broad matching criteria may create false positives.

cp_b.reason: The section describes two data techniques: data mining and data matching. These are core rules for using data in financial crime prevention, with the initial unit providing context.

units.zh: 使用数据挖掘发现可能被忽视的模式
units.en: Use data mining to uncover patterns that might otherwise go undetected.

units.zh: 使用数据匹配将不同数据集与固定标准进行核对
units.en: Use data matching to check data in different datasets against fixed criteria.

units.zh: 数据挖掘和匹配有助于改进金融犯罪预防和检测
units.en: Mining and matching are useful for improving financial crime prevention and detection.

cp_a.reason: This unit addresses the current lack of a universal AI framework and ongoing harmonization efforts, a distinct topic for review.

units.zh: 金融稳定委员会等国际机构呼吁协调AI法规
units.en: Lastly, while there is no universal AI framework, international bodies such as the Financial Stability Board have called for the harmonization of AI regulations.

cp_b.title_zh: 金融犯罪防控法规知识重要性
cp_b.reason: These two units emphasize the importance of understanding AFC regulation evolution and international standards for compliance and system protection, forming a coherent review point about foundational knowledge value.

units.zh: 了解金融犯罪防控法规演变有助于确保合规并保护金融体系
units.en: Knowing the evolution of AFC regulations helps ensure compliance and protect the financial system.

units.zh: 理解国际金融犯罪防控标准对自身控制措施的影响至关重要
units.en: Understanding how international AFC standards impact your AFC controls is essential.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Purpose and Notification for Customer Due Diligence Meetings

cp_a.title_zh: 慈善机构和非政府组织的研究与尽职调查步骤
cp_a.title_en: Research and Due Diligence Steps for Charities and NGOs
cp_a.reason: outlines key actions: verify registration, tax-exempt status, tax returns, and consult unbiased evaluations

units.zh: 研究慈善机构时应查询注册机构、免税状态和税务申报
units.en: While researching charities and NGOs, be sure to search the relevant registration authorities to confirm their exempt status and their annual tax return filings. Also, consult websites that provide unbiased evaluations of charities and NGOs. It is likely that larger organizations will have a list of approved websites to conduct this research.

cp_b.title_zh: 客户尽职调查会议的目的与通知
cp_b.title_en: Purpose and Notification for Customer Due Diligence Meetings
cp_b.reason: Introduces the necessity of customer engagement for due diligence and covers jurisdictional and advisory notification requirements, forming a coherent initial-stage review point.

units.zh: 必要时需与客户接触以收集尽职调查或调查所需的额外信息，通常由客户经理等面向客户的员工进行。
units.en: At times it will be necessary to engage with customers to gather additional information for due diligence or investigative purposes. Customer-facing employees, such as relationship managers, typically conduct these meetings, as they might already have a relationship with the customer.

units.zh: 某些司法管辖区要求提前通知客户机构将收集信息。
units.en: Some jurisdictions require advanced notification to customers that the organization will collect information.

units.zh: 即使未要求，也建议提前通知客户并说明数据用途，以减少客户疑虑。
units.en: Even if not required, providing this notice is advisable, as it helps reduce the impression that the organization is asking unnecessary questions. It is also advisable to tell the customer how the data will be used.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Regulatory Scrutiny and FCA Admonishment of Custodian Banks

cp_a.title_zh: 英国关键反洗钱/反恐融资立法
cp_a.reason: Groups the three explicitly listed key AML laws together as a review item on UK legislation.

units.zh: 英国《2002年犯罪收益法》是反洗钱关键立法之一。
units.en: Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

units.zh: 英国《2000年反恐怖主义法》是反恐融资关键立法之一。
units.en: The Terrorism Act 2000.

units.zh: 英国《2017年洗钱、恐怖融资与资金转移条例》是反洗钱关键立法之一。
units.en: Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017.

units.zh: 英国脱欧后反洗钱监管格局变化，仍为FATF成员并实施符合FATF标准的立法。
units.en: The UK’s AML/CFT regulatory landscape has changed following the UK’s exit from the EU in January 2020. Because it is not part of the EU or the EEA, the UK is not obligated to continue following the EU AMLDs, most recently the 6AMLD. In the current landscape, the UK remains a member of FATF and implements legislation that meets FATF’s AML/CFT global standards. The key legislation includes:

cp_b.title_zh: 监管审查与英国FCA对托管银行的警告
cp_b.title_en: Regulatory Scrutiny and FCA Admonishment of Custodian Banks
cp_b.reason: Regulatory trend and a specific case example together form a review point on increased oversight.

units.zh: 监管机构开始更密切地审查托管服务部门的金融犯罪风险。
units.en: Regulators have begun examining the custodial services sector more closely for financial crime risk.

units.zh: 2024年英国FCA批评托管银行反洗钱缺陷，强调需要严格的反洗钱控制。
units.en: For example, in 2024, the UK’s FCA admonished custodian banks for their AML shortcomings and emphasized the need for rigorous AML controls. They cited a variety of common failings, including discrepancies between registered and actual activities, inadequate AML resources, and failure to assess customer activity risks.
